comments: Engine: axe-core (Deque Systems). Our part is the rule library with plain-language explanations in seven languages and the mapping to WCAG 2.2 and EN 301 549 (https://pandus.online/en/rules). No signup needed for one page; paid plans check whole sites weekly. We do not offer an overlay and do not change the checked site. This is the free one-page checker; the overall Pandus service was submitted separately (pull request #1375).
features: Free online checker that tests one web page against WCAG 2.2 levels A and AA with axe-core in a real browser. Each issue is explained in plain language, linked to its success criterion and EN 301 549 clause, with fixes for Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop and Shoptet. Results in 7 languages. Automated check, not a full audit.
title: Pandus WCAG Checker
